stem:
Part of a quadratic function is shown on the grid.

Which statement best represents the domain of the part of the function shown?

options.label: A
options.text: All real numbers less than or equal to 5

options.label: B
options.text: All real numbers greater than or equal to 3

options.label: C
options.text: All real numbers greater than or equal to 1

visual_elements: graph of quadratic function from x=1 to x=5
